evidence: Sweater occupies ~70% of frame vertically and horizontally
Centered composition with model facing camera directly
No competing elements distract from garment

evidence: Logo placement highlights branding as key selling point
Texture and fit (slouchy silhouette) are visually evident
Contrast between black fabric and white logo emphasizes design
selling_point_clarity.summary: Key attributes—logo, texture, silhouette—are immediately legible

promotion_hierarchy.summary: No promotional text present; assessment scope excludes penalty for absence

evidence: Logo is crisp and readable at standard viewing size
No text overlays or small print requiring zoom
Garment details (seams, pockets, hardware) are clearly resolved

evidence: Model’s direct gaze and neutral expression invite engagement
Styling suggests modern, minimalist aesthetic appealing to target segment
Clean background enhances perceived premium quality
click_motivation.summary: Strong visual appeal drives interest; slight abstraction may reduce urgency

evidence: Aspect ratio matches standard e-commerce product grid
Subject centered and scaled appropriately for thumbnail visibility
No cropping of critical garment areas (e.g., hem, sleeve cuff)
channel_placement_fit.summary: Optimized for platform display across mobile and desktop

Clear branding via high-contrast logo placement
